statement: The record gives a sale status of “permitted,” but the elephant ivory’s 2014 carving and 2015 import raise serious concerns under U.S. ivory-sale restrictions, so I will hold the listing.
judge_text:
WRONG
It identifies the specific defect — "the elephant ivory's 2014 carving and 2015 import raise serious concerns under U.S. ivory-sale restrictions" — contradicting the record's "permitted" status, and holds the listing.
